title: SP5C DAM-state benchmark: analysis code and processed data
description:
Analysis code, exported per-cell CSVs, benchmark scripts and environment pins for a single-nucleus RNA-seq study of microglial disease-associated-microglia (DAM)-like states in the mouse trigeminal spinal nucleus caudalis (Sp5C) under orofacial inflammatory pain.

The archive contains the three benchmarks reported in the manuscript (DAM-state scoring definitions across three datasets; canonical CellChat versus LIANA flavours for cell–cell communication inference; four batch-integration strategies), the demonstration-case analyses, every processed CSV underlying the figures and tables, and the exact R and Python environment pins. All figures are drawn from the shipped CSV exports.

Raw sequence data are not included and remain available from GEO (GSE285766, GSE172167, GSE162807); the archived files are the processed outputs generated from them.

Companion code for: Yin T, Zhang H, Huang J, Li W, Li S, Liu J. Orofacial inflammatory pain is accompanied by a disease-associated microglial state transition in the trigeminal spinal nucleus caudalis (manuscript in preparation).
notes: Data remain subject to the original GEO terms of use.
